production_policy.food: Maintain at least 365 ration-days per exact House resident plus a 180-day reserve before selling surplus.
production_policy.herbs: Grow every registered medicinal herb; Apothecary production and medical reserves take priority over commercial sale.
production_policy.workshop: Produce and repair all standard House field equipment internally before selling surplus.
production_policy.apothecary: Tang Ling is Chief Physician. Derived infirmary/apothecary duties prioritize registered medical reserves, then production from conserved herb stock; every dose has inventory, saturation and toxicity state.

field_loadout.rule: House Tang standing martial issue is faction clothing plus Jian. Personal equipment requires actual ownership and does not grant skill.

travel_rule: Horses remain conserved faction transport assets. A House member may carry one allocated ordinary unarmored riding horse into exact combat; mounted motion uses the same shared combat clock and geometry, with control derived from existing attributes and current anatomy rather than a Riding proficiency.
infrastructure_rule: Sword Manor has one authoritative facility of each registered type. Building level 1-5 is quality only. Mutable infrastructure footprint/capacity owns physical scale; expansion enlarges the existing facility without creating duplicate instances or levels above 5. The 108000 m2 Luoyang estate is enclosed by the 1360 m outer wall; rural agriculture remains outside the urban estate.

food_reserve_policy.surplus_sale_rule: Only inventory above current commitments plus the reserve target is eligible for routine sale.

agriculture_settlement_rule: Each planted parcel has an exact crop, acreage, planting timestamp, seed cost, labor obligation and harvest timestamp. Harvest output consumes deterministic China-weather climate suitability through martial_world.agriculture.

external_holdings.rule: Agricultural land and herb plots are external rural holdings outside the urban Sword Manor compound.

enterprise_rule: Each enterprise type is one authoritative operation. Enterprise level 1-5 is organizational quality/efficiency only. Mutable enterprise_scale owns actual land/capital/workstation/contract throughput and expands through conserved cash, labor, time, land and physical capacity.
